zh: 全面对齐移动端（iOS 与 Android）版本号与桌面端/Web端（v1.0.x），实现全端版本完全统一。
精简内置技能体 Prompt 篇幅并拓宽字符上限，确保 CI 自动化测试在跨系统环境稳定运行。
自动处理并校验 iOS 1024x1024 图标无透明通道，满足 App Store 官方上架与 TestFlight 分发规范。
en: Unify mobile (iOS and Android) versioning with desktop and web releases (v1.0.x) for total cross-platform consistency.
Streamline builtin skill prompts and relax character bounds for rock-solid cross-platform CI test execution.
Enforce opaque iOS 1024x1024 app icons during build to satisfy Apple App Store and TestFlight validation rules.
